# Getting help

Timestamp Cleaner is a development project maintained in spare time. There is no
supported stable release, guaranteed response time or paid support service.

Read the [README](../README.md), [media-tool setup and recovery guide](../docs/media-tools.md)
and [known validation gaps](../VALIDATION.md) first. For questions and workflow advice,
use [Discussions](https://github.com/MrQuality/timestamp-cleaner/discussions). For a
reproducible defect or focused feature proposal, use the corresponding
[issue template](https://github.com/MrQuality/timestamp-cleaner/issues/new/choose).

Include the application commit, operating system, FFmpeg/FFprobe versions and redacted
error text. Use synthetic media or commands that reproduce the problem. Do not share
family recordings, credentials, identifying metadata or private filesystem paths.

Report vulnerabilities through the [private security channel](https://github.com/MrQuality/timestamp-cleaner/security/advisories/new).
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for development and pull requests.
